sections.content: Use the futuro simple to state longer-term intentions and goals. It works naturally with vocabulary about work, study, projects and personal objectives. Expressions such as el próximo año and en el futuro make the time frame clear. The focus is on what you intend or expect to do in the future.

items.english: I will save money to travel.
I will work on a new project.

sections.content: *Seguiré estudiando* works the same way *seguir* + gerund always does — it's just wearing the futuro simple on the outer verb instead of *ir a*. Spot *seguir* as 'keep on' regardless of which tense carries it.
